title: Backflow preventer winterization: protect the assembly without bypassing requirements
description: Winterization is an assembly-specific seasonal process.
prompt: What can be protected seasonally without creating a backflow or freeze failure?
answer: Winterization is an assembly-specific seasonal process. It depends on device location, manufacturer instructions, local irrigation shutdown practice, and safe isolation; it is not an invitation to dismantle or bypass protection components.
urgency: Escalate any freeze crack, uncertain shutoff sequence, or inability to identify the installed assembly.
identifiers: Record outdoor exposure, model, size, and connected irrigation or water system.
Freeze protection is different from internal component repair.
A spring return-to-service may require inspection or testing under local rules.
